entries.clue: Crispy shredded bird rolled into thin pancakes with cucumber and spring onion
Four and a quarter miles of Oxford against Cambridge each spring
Oar caught by the water at the finish, which can pitch a rower out
Inner tower where the crown jewels were shown from 1870 until 1967
Sweet sticky mango preserve spooned from the little steel dish on the tray
Mild curry of cream, coconut and ground almonds, ordered by anyone avoiding heat
Ceremonial ornaments of a coronation, guarded here since Charles II
Nickname of uncertain origin borne by the warders who live inside the walls
Royal regatta rowed two abreast on a straight stretch of the Thames
Hot restaurant curry that borrows the former name of the city now called Chennai
